errors.text: The proposed 920 °C Mg-Al transient-liquid intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention of SPS at 1000 °C applied to ball-milled MgAlTiVFeCo BCC powder.
No cited evidence directly establishes a Mg-Al-Ti transient liquid, greater than 98% density, or retention of a single-phase-like BCC structure at 920 °C in the proposed alloy.

The falsification experiment does not compare intermediate temperatures within 800-1000 °C against the proposed optimum; it changes composition and includes a 1050 °C condition outside the allowed window.
The experiment omits oxidation kinetics and electrochemical corrosion measurements, so it cannot falsify the claimed improvement in barrier properties.
The claimed MgO/Al2O3 barrier and suppression of all secondary phases conflict with the target mediator, which involves uniformly distributed AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 barrier phases.
